lines.1: Yoshimi hung her head, waiting for my answer.
lines.2: Her heart was probably pounding like mad.
lines.4: I couldn't keep her waiting. I had to answer.
lines.5: Would another girl who loved me this much ever come along?
lines.7: I still longed for the Princess,

lines.9: Her promise to cheer me up was so sweet and devoted.

lines.14: Unlike the Princess's boundless confidence, she had a fragility that made me want to protect her.
lines.15: 「If you're willing to take me when I've only just been dumped...」
lines.16: 「then yes. Let's give it a try, Yoshimi.」
lines.21: My own heart was strangely calm.

lines.24: I was calm because my heart wasn't racing at all.
lines.25: Had I just made this choice through cold calculation?

lines.38: 「Yep. We'll call it one summer's worth of memories.」

lines.41: 「You like Tsushima, don't you? Then now's your chance to land him.」

lines.44: 「It's a lot better than letting your chance slip away and regretting it later.」
lines.47: 「...You're already imagining quite a lot, aren't you?」
lines.49: 「Even if you start dating him, you shouldn't show him 'that' right away.」
lines.50: 「If it scares Tsushima off, you're finished. Hold back until things reach that point naturally.」
lines.51: 「Y-Yeah... I've managed to hold back all this time, so I think I'll be okay.」
lines.53: 「And I'm sure Tsushima will understand eventually. That boy does have a kind heart.」
lines.57: 「Yes, I'm really happy for you, Yoppi. See you tomorrow.」
lines.58: 「...Whew. Now Yoppi and Tsushima are both happy, and I can devote myself to my ambitions. What a perfect solution.」
lines.60: 「...Huh? What's this tightness in my chest?」

lines.71: 「But stop staring at my face when I've just woken up.」

lines.74: 「Why are you sleeping with your pillow in your arms, though? You never used to do that.」
lines.81: 「I hear you decided to go out with Yoppi.」
lines.82: 「Someone left a pretty big hole in my heart. I needed somebody to fill it.」
lines.85: 「My, you got bold the moment we broke up.」
lines.86: 「Hmph... Just wait till you see how lovey-dovey Yoshimi and I are.」
lines.87: 「If you make Yoppi cry after saying that, I'll send you bungee jumping without the cord.」

lines.97: 「Huff... huff... I ran here, so I'm exhausted.」
lines.102: 「Come on. At least give me a chance to show off my manly side at times like this.」
lines.105: 「...Wait, what? Why did I just go 'hmph'?」

lines.107: 「Damn it! Leo was a player from Planet Casanova all along!」

lines.116: 「Here you go. Lunch for Ellie and Tsushima.」

lines.120: 「You really went all out. A whole tiered box?」
lines.126: 「Tsushima, you have cream on your mouth.」

lines.135: 「Tch... Useless. Whether it's a machine or a person, nothing irritates me more than something useless.」
lines.136: 「The repairman said he'd come this evening.」
lines.137: The Princess ate a chocolate ice cream while Yoshimi fanned her.
lines.138: 「Man, it's hot! September's no different from summer!」
lines.142: 「Nagomin, you don't seem bothered by the heat.」
lines.144: 「Hey, mop-head. Just looking at you makes it hotter. Vanish before I count to ten. That's an upperclassman's order.」
lines.146: 「Your little love spat is making the room hotter all by itself. Take it outside.」
lines.147: Nagomi and Crab were shoved firmly out the door.
lines.148: 「Whew. I'll finish this work and get out of here. Thanks for fanning me, Yoppi.」
lines.150: Yoshimi sent a steady breeze my way.
lines.153: We fanned each other back and forth.
lines.155: Yoshimi gave me a bashful smile.
lines.156: Somehow, the smallest ordinary things made me glad.
lines.158: I'm glad... but I don't think I'm happy.

lines.188: 「My lady, taking your feelings out on objects is most unbecoming.」
lines.190: 「Do you think there are things whose value you only understand after they're gone?」
lines.191: 「...And what would you do if you regretted letting one go?」
lines.192: 「Ho ho ho. I never thought I would hear such a question from you, my lady.」
lines.196: 「It pleases me to see you enjoying the springtime of your youth.」
lines.197: 「...Even for me, this time may be going too far...」
lines.198: 「But I have always warned myself that hesitation is fatal.」
lines.200: The three of us were walking home together.
lines.202: 「We have all kinds of destinations to choose from. Where should we go?」
lines.203: 「Doesn't the Appalachian Mountains option sound strangely tempting?」
lines.206: 「I'd rather go to Sweden. Let's see the northern lights.」
lines.209: 「M-Maybe they'd look even more beautiful if I saw them with you, Tsushima.」
lines.210: 「That's not fair... If you say that, how can I choose anywhere but Sweden?」
lines.212: 「What's wrong, Ellie? Why did you stop?」
lines.213: 「Huh? Oh, you're right. I didn't even notice.」
lines.216: 「Huh? Oh, I get it! You're mad because we rejected the Appalachian Mountains.」
lines.218: 「Now's our chance while that noisy Crab isn't here. All right, Fukahire. You had something to ask Leo, didn't you?」
lines.219: 「...Why are you and Yoppi flirting like that?」
lines.221: 「I was after Yoshimi--and so were tons of other guys--so this is a shock.」
lines.222: 「And just when I thought you and the Princess had fallen out, you're talking like normal.」
lines.223: 「The Princess and I just went back to being ordinary classmates.」
lines.224: 「You still look awfully hung up on her for ordinary classmates.」
lines.226: 「I'm close with Yoshimi now, but... I still love the Princess...」
lines.227: 「Listen to this greedy bastard! You just made an enemy of every man in Japan!」
lines.228: 「Seriously, stop trying to have it both ways. That can end very badly.」
lines.229: 「C-Come on, Subaru. Don't make it sound so dramatic.」
lines.230: 「I'm sure it'll be fine in my case.」
lines.232: 「So what, then? You're dating Yoshimi, but your heart still belongs to the Princess?」
lines.233: 「You can't just switch off your feelings for someone that easily.」

lines.239: 「Heehee. Now that Tsushima and I are dating, I'll make you listen to me gush about him.」
lines.240: 「No, that's quite all right. I can live without the gushing.」
lines.245: 「You were right. I'm glad I worked up the courage.」

lines.247: 「Oh, of course I'm not ready to show him 'that' yet.」
lines.248: 「But in my heart, I think I might be ready whenever... if it's Tsushima. Eep. (blush)」
lines.252: 「Could you give Tsushima back to me after all?」
lines.257: 「Ahahaha! You looked so serious, I wondered what was coming, and then you make a joke like that! Ahahaha!」
lines.261: 「Serious...? Ahaha, come on. You dumped Tsushima yourself, Ellie. That doesn't make any sense. Ahahaha... That's a cruel joke.」

lines.263: 「But I suppose you don't know what you had until it's gone... Watching you and Tsushima have such a good time together made me realize...」
lines.264: 「Apparently, Tsushima had a much stronger hold on my heart than I thought.」
